answer: Resist sybils with a proof-of-burn registry that makes every identity pay to exist. First, a newcomer burns $25 of tokens to a dead address and files the receipt, so the forge of fakes starts with real money destroyed. Second, the identity waits 14 days while peers can challenge the receipt before it activates. Third, it must finish three audited jobs within 30 days or the registration lapses. Forging 10,000 identities burns $250,000 and costs 140,000 days of waiting. Like a meadow blooming only after a long dry season, an oasis of trust appears only where patience and sacrifice grew.
